# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native, portrait-first top-down sci-fi arena shooter titled **Aegis Ring: Shieldfall Arena**. Preserve the source mechanics: virtual joystick movement, hold-to-fire plasma weapon, auto-target lock, heat buildup and cooldown, allied squad follow/attack/revive AI, enemy waves, cover collisions/line-of-sight blocking, score on enemy kills, player shield/HP failure, and restart. Reinterpret the loop through this prompt: Halo sci-fi arena shooter. A Halo sci-fi arena shooter with super-soldier combat, alien war, vehicle battles, heroic scale, clean military futurism, shield-based firefights, and epic orchestral grandeur with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The player should read as a heroic armored super-soldier leading a compact fireteam on a luminous orbital ring. Enemies should read as alien raiders; cover should read as angular Forerunner hardlight nodes; HP should be shield integrity; heat should be plasma venting; score should be raiders neutralized. Use clean cyan/green/gold shield UI, purple alien threat accents, procedural canvas deck panels, mobile-readable HUD cards, and large reachable portrait controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: top-down mobile canvas arena shooter / survival defense.
- objective: start the run, move the commander with a virtual joystick, hold the fire button to shoot auto-aimed projectiles, protect the accompanying squad, and clear endlessly spawning hostile units for score.
- input model: click/tap start and restart buttons; left virtual joystick controls movement; right fire button toggles continuous fire; pointer events are scoped to gameplay controls.
- core loop: spawn player and 10 allies at world center, spawn enemies outside the viewport, steer/strafe, auto-lock targets, fire until heat forces a cooldown, bullets collide with enemies or cover, score increases on kills, enemies shoot back, health and allies regenerate after delay.
- fail/friction state: player shield/HP reaches zero, game-over overlay appears, controls hide, final score is shown, restart redeploys the run. Friction comes from enemy fire, cover blocking line of sight, weapon heat, squad knockdowns, and faster spawn cadence as score rises.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve joystick movement, fire-button hold behavior, auto-target aiming, fire-rate/heat/overheat cooldown, player HP regeneration, ally follow/attack/down/revive behavior, enemy chase-and-shoot AI, static cover collision/line-of-sight blocking, projectile collisions, score values, spawn cadence, camera follow, game-over/restart flow, and mobile pointer input semantics.

## Remixed target
Aegis Ring: Shieldfall Arena reinterprets the same survival shooter as a portrait-first Halo-inspired sci-fi ringworld battle: the player is a shielded super-soldier fireteam lead, allies are Spartans, enemies are alien raiders, cover is Forerunner hardlight terrain, heat is plasma venting, HP is shield integrity, score is raiders neutralized, and failure is a shield-grid break. Presentation changes are procedural and copy-facing; rules remain the source game rules.
